attributes.action: Mandatory requirement for Air Conditioning in all Nursery and School settings.
attributes.additional_details: We want the government to make it law that air conditioning must be installed in all nurseries and school settings. With climate change and temperatures increasing, we feel we need to ensure our young children are not left in uncomfortable, hot rooms.
attributes.background:
There is currently no active regulation which mandates air conditioning in all UK nurseries, nor is there a legal requirement for early years providers to install AC. 

The Workplace Health, Safety and Welfare Regulations 1992 does not specify a maximum temperature for work settings either.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petitions, which call for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023

Introduce a maximum safe temperature for Early Years settings
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774280
